observation_unit: One saved tracked-person observation per source frame. Duplicates and fragmented identities may remain; this is not a roster.
timestamps: Zero-based source frame_idx / constant source fps, in seconds.
nulls: JSON null and empty CSV cells mean unknown/unavailable, never zero. Unknown roles, teams and jersey numbers are retained.

files.observations.csv: Flat observations for both clips; each clip also has observations.csv.
files.frames.jsonl: One complete frame per line: original detections, enriched tracks, calibration and image_to_court_h. Raw detections stay unclassified. Masks are source-image polygon coordinates.
files.persons.json: Summaries by automatic person hypothesis, not real roster identity; observation gaps have unknown cause.
files.classification-evidence.json: Per-person decisions, abstention reasons, sample images/hashes, cosine scores, torso CIELAB samples and two anonymous team centroids.
files.metadata.json: Source hashes, output hashes, current CPU timings, historical stage timings/configuration and versions.
files.experiment.json: Complete configuration, model hash, versions, source hashes, runtime scopes and limitations. No full-pipeline benchmark is claimed.
files.evaluation.json: Optional separate visual spot check. Human labels are evaluation-only and never enter inference or overwrite predictions.

fields.clip: Source clip identifier; team labels and person hypotheses are clip-local.
fields.track_id: Original raw tracker label; not a jersey number or verified identity.
fields.person_id: CSV name for JSON player_id: automatic linked-person hypothesis. Legacy name player_id does not imply player role.
fields.identity_segment_id: Automatic segment of a raw tracker label. Unknown identity is null.
fields.identity_status: Preserved upstream identity status, not a verified accuracy label.
fields.x1,y1,x2,y2: Person bounding box in source-image pixels; JSON name bbox_xyxy.
fields.det_confidence: Original detector score, not identity or position confidence.
fields.role: player, referee, other_person, or null. Experimental automatic whole-clip classification.
fields.role_scores_json: JSON object of median CLIP cosine similarities. Not probabilities; JSON field role_scores.
fields.role_margin: Difference between the two largest median role cosine similarities.
fields.role_agreement: Fraction of sampled appearances with the same winning role as the aggregate.
fields.role_samples: Number of scored appearances, not independent people.
fields.team_id: A, B, or null. Two uniform groups assumed, fitted to automatically predicted players; sorted by centroid lightness. No cross-clip roster mapping.
fields.team_margin_lab: Difference between median distance to the alternative and chosen CIELAB team centroids.
fields.team_agreement: Fraction of usable color samples nearest to the chosen centroid.
fields.team_samples: Number of usable masked torso-color samples.
fields.team_distances_lab_json: Median sample-to-centroid Euclidean CIELAB distances, in A/B order; not probabilities.
fields.court_x_m,court_y_m: Smoothed approximate floor coordinates in metres in the inherited court-template axes; nominal 28 x 15 m. JSON court_xy_m.
fields.camera_smoothed_x_m,camera_smoothed_y_m: Floor projection after camera smoothing and before player-position smoothing; JSON court_xy_camera_smoothed_m.
fields.foot_x_px,foot_y_px: Bounding-box bottom-center proxy in source-image pixels; JSON footpoint_image_xy. Actual floor contact unverified.
fields.foot_contact_visibility: Preserved visibility status; unknown is not verified contact.
fields.position_source: Inherited measured-model / smoothed / estimated-calibration / unavailable provenance. No missing player observations are filled.
fields.court_region: Inherited geometric region; not a role classifier or verified in-play status.
fields.calibration_method: Per-frame inherited camera-calibration/smoothing method. Gap estimates remain marked estimated.
fields.projection_quality_json: Inherited calibration and floor-point caveats; JSON court_projection_quality.
fields.classification_evidence_id: Key into classification-evidence.json. Null when identity is unknown.
fields.classification_temporal_scope: JSON-only: whole_clip_person_hypothesis. Future appearances are used; this is not causal per-frame role inference.

court_axes_reference: Template geometry and source camera matrices are retained in frame JSONL and review-data.json. This coordinate system does not encode attacking direction.
